description: Plain arithmetic: how many nights a tank of water lasts for a number of people at a stated use per person per day, and how far a tank of gas goes at a stated mileage. Nothing is read from a record. Any default rate (1 gallon per person per day, 13 mpg, the game's numbers) is labeled in the answer as an assumption you can change; it is not a fact about a place.

gas_gal.description: Gallons of gas in the tank.

mpg.description: Optional: your rig's miles per gallon. Default 13 (an assumption, the game's pavement number).

nights.description: Optional: nights planned, to say whether the water is enough.

people.description: How many people use the water.

water_gal_per_person_per_day.description: Optional: gallons each person uses a day. Default 1 (an assumption).

name: rig_math
title: Water and gas math for a rig
